dataset_name: City of Seattle Building Energy Benchmarking Data
publisher: City of Seattle Office of Sustainability & Environment
license: Public Domain / City of Seattle Open Data Terms of Use
redistribution: Open access, unrestricted research and commercial reuse

dimensions.geographic_coverage: Seattle, Washington, USA (Latitude: 47.49 - 47.73 N, Longitude: -122.44 - -122.24 W)

target_variables.primary_target_description: Total annual greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1 direct fossil fuel + Scope 2 indirect electricity emissions)
target_variables.primary_target_units: Metric Tons of CO2 equivalent per year (Metric Tons CO2e / yr)
target_variables.intensity_target_description: Total greenhouse gas emissions normalized by building gross floor area

target_provenance_and_accounting_boundar.calculation_engine: U.S. EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager
target_provenance_and_accounting_boundar.scope_1_activity: NaturalGas(therms) converted via EPA fuel emission factor (~0.0531 MT CO2e/MMBtu or ~5.3 kg CO2e/therm)
target_provenance_and_accounting_boundar.scope_2_activity: Electricity(kWh) converted via Seattle City Light utility-specific / eGRID regional emission factor
target_provenance_and_accounting_boundar.steam_activity: SteamUse(kBtu) converted via Seattle Steam Company / Enwave district energy emission factor
target_provenance_and_accounting_boundar.ground_truth_classification: Statutory reporting estimate based on verified utility meter aggregations. It measures agreement with standardized EPA emissions accounting rather than direct stack gas sensor measurement.

leakage_controls.activity_data_role: Used strictly for computing the Conventional Activity x Emission Factor Accounting Baseline, and withheld from the primary physical-structural ML feature matrix to prevent trivial formula identity leakage.
